scope: combined420 only; three paired acoustic seeds, fixed fusion seed; random controls reuse audited runs; encoder frozen
mining: After shared first 4000 updates, exactly half of query slots choose max frozen-encoder equal-phone score from eight distinct same-corpus impostors including the original negative; remaining slots and all queries unchanged. Shared genuine/impostor phone mask identical to existing training. No evaluation input used in mining.
selection: lowest equal-corpus validation EER including common prefix; earliest ties; final checkpoint secondary
evaluation: Freeze all models then all validation FAR1pct thresholds before scoring any new test. Previously observed tests; exploratory. Do not choose seeds, budget or sampling parameters from test results.
